titleText.es: ¿Completamente implausible? Sí. Sin embargo, merece la pena tener un bote de repelente de tiburones al lado de la cama.
titleText.en: Completely implausible? Yes. Nevertheless, worth keeping a can of shark repellent next to the bed.
titleText.noteEn: The Spanish raster translates the dialogue and changes the official sound effects SPLOOSH, CLICK, HISSS, and CHOMP CHOMP to SPLAASH, CLIC, SSSSSS, and ÑAM ÑAM. It leaves CHUNK unchanged, so CHUNK is excluded while the localized sounds are taught. The Spanish image also uses singular LA CÁPSULA where the official image says THE CAPSULES, and it omits the official capsule's small IF FOUND PLEASE CALL label; this artifact follows the Spanish image exactly. The title and title text preserve the joke about science outreach accidentally carrying a live shark to the public.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Dispositivo names a piece of equipment made for a particular purpose.

example.es: El dispositivo mide la temperatura.
example.en: The device measures the temperature.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Registrará is the future form of registrar for one person or thing.

example.es: El sensor registrará cada cambio.
example.en: The sensor will record every change.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Movimientos is the plural of movimiento and can describe changes in position or a path followed over time.

example.es: La cámara sigue los movimientos del animal.
example.en: The camera follows the animal's movements.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Hábitos are repeated behaviors or routines. The written accent remains in the plural.

example.es: Estudian los hábitos nocturnos de las aves.
example.en: They study the birds' nighttime habits.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Tiburón is the general Spanish word for a shark.

example.es: Vieron un tiburón cerca del barco.
example.en: They saw a shark near the boat.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Soltará is a future form of soltar. With se, it can describe something detaching or coming free without naming a person who releases it.

example.es: La pieza se soltará con el movimiento.
example.en: The piece will come loose with the movement.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Subirá is the future form of subir for one person or thing.

example.es: El globo subirá lentamente.
example.en: The balloon will rise slowly.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Superficie is the outside or upper level of something, including the top of a body of water.

example.es: La boya volvió a la superficie.
example.en: The buoy returned to the surface.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: In poder permitirse algo, permitir is part of the expression for having enough money, time, or resources for something. This differs from permitir meaning to allow.

example.es: No podemos permitirnos otro gasto.
example.en: We cannot afford another expense.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Here programa is a planned set of activities or services, not a computer program.

example.es: La ciudad creó un programa de reciclaje.
example.en: The city created a recycling program.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Recuperación can mean getting an object back as well as returning to health or a previous condition.

example.es: La recuperación del equipo tardó dos días.
example.en: Retrieving the equipment took two days.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Cápsula can be a small sealed container that protects equipment or material.

example.es: La cápsula protege el instrumento.
example.en: The capsule protects the instrument.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Inflará is the future form of inflar for one person or thing.

example.es: La bomba inflará el globo.
example.en: The pump will inflate the balloon.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Globo can name a small rubber balloon or a larger balloon used to rise through the air.

example.es: El globo ascendió sobre el campo.
example.en: The balloon rose over the field.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Helio is the light chemical element used to make some balloons rise.

example.es: Llenaron el globo de helio.
example.en: They filled the balloon with helium.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Flotará is the future form of flotar for one person or thing.

example.es: La boya flotará hasta la costa.
example.en: The buoy will float to the coast.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: This sense contrasts land with the sea. It does not name the planet Earth or soil as a material.

example.es: Después de horas en el mar, vimos tierra.
example.en: After hours at sea, we saw land.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Encontrará is the future form of encontrar for one person or thing.

example.es: Alguien encontrará la caja.
example.en: Someone will find the box.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Mandará is the future form of mandar for one person or thing. Mandar can mean to send an object or message.

example.es: Marta nos mandará la foto mañana.
example.en: Marta will send us the photo tomorrow.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: This sense of correo is the physical postal service used for letters and parcels. Correo electrónico or email identifies electronic mail when the distinction matters.

example.es: La carta llegó por correo.
example.en: The letter arrived by mail.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Splaash is a stretched comic-book sound for a large object entering water. The extra a suggests a longer or larger splash.

example.es: La piedra cayó al agua: ¡splaash!
example.en: The rock fell into the water: splash!

cardDefinitions.noteEn: A run of s letters can represent a sustained hiss, such as air leaving a valve or filling a balloon.

example.es: La válvula hizo «ssssss».
example.en: The valve went “hissss.”

cardDefinitions.noteEn: A long run of a letters represents a sustained scream. The number of letters varies with the desired length or intensity.

example.es: Desde el pasillo se oyó «¡aaaaaaaaa!».
example.en: A long scream was heard from the hallway.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Ñam is a common Spanish sound for taking a bite or eating eagerly. Repeating it suggests repeated bites.

example.es: El niño miró el pastel y dijo: «¡Ñam!».
example.en: The child looked at the cake and said, “Yum!”

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Papi is an affectionate, familiar way to address or refer to one's father.

example.es: Papi, ¿puedo hacerte una pregunta?
example.en: Daddy, can I ask you a question?

cardDefinitions.noteEn: As a noun, científica names a woman or girl who works in science. The matching masculine form is científico.

example.es: Ana quiere ser científica.
example.en: Ana wants to be a scientist.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you say “tracking device” in Spanish?
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Spanish uses de to connect the device to its purpose. English commonly places tracking directly before device instead.

example.es: Colocaron un dispositivo de seguimiento en la caja.
example.en: They put a tracking device on the box.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you say that an object comes loose or detaches?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: Use a matching form of soltarse.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: The short pronoun changes with the subject and comes before a finite verb: la pieza se suelta, las piezas se soltaron. The dictionary form keeps se attached: soltarse.

example.es: La etiqueta se soltó durante el viaje.
example.en: The label came loose during the trip.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you say that someone cannot afford something?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: Use no, a matching form of poder, and permitirse.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: The person pronoun from permitirse normally appears before the changed form of poder: no me puedo permitir, no nos podemos permitir. The thing that is unaffordable follows the expression.

example.es: No me puedo permitir un viaje este año.
example.en: I cannot afford a trip this year.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you name a balloon filled with helium?
cardDefinitions.noteEn: De links the balloon to the gas inside it. English usually places helium directly before balloon.

example.es: El globo de helio llegó al techo.
example.en: The helium balloon reached the ceiling.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you introduce a hoped-for result with “hopefully” or “with luck”?
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Con suerte comments on the chance that the following event will happen. It can appear at the beginning or inside a sentence.

example.es: Con suerte, llegaremos antes de la lluvia.
example.en: With luck, we will arrive before the rain.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you say that something is sent or received by mail?
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Por introduces the delivery or communication channel. Correo can refer to postal mail or email; the surrounding context tells which one.

example.es: Te enviaré el contrato por correo.
example.en: I will send you the contract by mail.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you order a person pronoun and a thing pronoun before a verb that changes for person and time?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: Put the person pronoun first, the thing pronoun second, and both before the changed verb.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: The slashes mean to choose one item, and the plus signs show the order. For example, nos la mandará places nos for the recipients before la for the feminine thing. Before lo, la, los, or las, le and les change to se.

example.es: Nos la enviarán mañana.
example.en: They will send it to us tomorrow.

cardDefinitions.promptEs: dispositivo de seguimiento · tiburón · globo de helio · científica
cardDefinitions.answerEn: The tracking capsule is supposed to detach from the shark, inflate a helium balloon, cross land, and be returned by mail. It fails to detach, so the balloon carries the shark to people instead; the disastrous demonstration still inspires a child to become a scientist.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: The official title Outreach refers both to presenting science to the public and to the apparatus literally reaching the public. The title text extends the airborne-shark absurdity by recommending shark repellent beside the bed.

applications.explanationEn: No negates the expression; nos identifies the group that lacks the resources; podemos carries the changed verb and permitir remains unchanged.
Podemos carries the person and time, while permitir stays in its unchanged dictionary form.
The two words form one connector that introduces the result of not funding retrieval.
De helio identifies the gas inside the balloon rather than ownership.
The future ending -á follows the complete form inflar.

applications.explanationEn: The fixed two-word expression introduces the hoped-for outcome.
La replaces the feminine capsule and appears directly before the future verb encontrará.
La replaces the feminine capsule and appears directly before mandará.
Nos identifies the recipients and stands before the future verb mandará; la appears between them because it identifies the thing sent rather than the recipient.
Nos identifies the recipients, la identifies the feminine capsule, and both precede the changed verb in that order.
Por introduces correo as the channel used to return the capsule.
The future ending -á follows the complete dictionary form encontrar.
The future ending -á follows the complete form mandar.
